method: Enumerate effective runtime command registries across all discovered contexts and node types. Capture handler identity and source candidates. Source scanning inventories GUI controls/import dependencies/tests. Mode/context arrays consolidate shared inherited registrations; No/default forms retain selected parser observations; their exhaustive configuration and runtime semantics remain unverified. Does not equate registry presence, test-name matches, or parser acceptance with behavior or Cisco fidelity.

scope.unit: One node + canonical registered path + handler hash; modes and context entries are consolidated. Windows and Unix variants each use a separate explicit syntax unit. Parser evidence binds only actually reached matching node/path/handler/mode observations. Behavior/native status remains separate; arguments and no/default state semantics require separate evidence.
